---
title: "generateRandomString (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: length = 32 (default)
    q_validate --> q_generate: crypto.randomBytes(length)
    q_generate --> [*]: return bytes.toString('hex')

    note right of q_generate
        INV-001: Output length equals length * 2 (hex encoding doubles byte count)
        INV-002: Output contains only hexadecimal characters [0-9a-f]
    end note

---
title: "hashClientSecret (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_hash: bcrypt.hash(secret, 10)
    q_hash --> [*]: return hashed_secret

    note right of q_hash
        INV-001: Salt rounds = 10 (hardcoded)
        INV-002: Output is a valid bcrypt hash string
        INV-003: bcrypt.compare(secret, output) = true
    end note

---
title: "verifyClientSecret (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_compare: bcrypt.compare(secret, hash)
    q_compare --> q_true: match = true
    q_compare --> q_false: match = false
    q_true --> [*]: return true
    q_false --> [*]: return false

    note right of q_compare
        INV-001: Timing-safe comparison (bcrypt internal)
        INV-002: Returns true iff secret hashes to hash
    end note

---
title: "verifyCodeChallenge (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_method: method default = 'S256'
    q_check_method --> q_reject: method != 'S256'
    q_check_method --> q_hash: method == 'S256'
    q_reject --> [*]: return false
    q_hash --> q_compare: hash = SHA256(verifier).base64url
    q_compare --> q_match: hash == challenge
    q_compare --> q_nomatch: hash != challenge
    q_match --> [*]: return true
    q_nomatch --> [*]: return false

    note right of q_hash
        INV-001: Only S256 method is supported; plain method always rejected
        INV-002: SHA-256 digest is base64url-encoded (RFC 7636 compliant)
        INV-003: Returns true iff SHA256(verifier) == challenge
    end note

---
title: "generateAccessToken (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_time: now = floor(Date.now() / 1000)
    q_time --> q_build: build claims = payload + iss + aud + iat + exp
    q_build --> q_sign: jwt.sign(claims, JWT_SECRET, HS256)
    q_sign --> [*]: return signed_token

    note right of q_build
        INV-001: iss = JWT_ISSUER (from env or localhost:3000)
        INV-002: aud = clientId parameter
        INV-003: exp = iat + 30 days (TOKEN_EXPIRY.ACCESS_TOKEN)
        INV-004: Algorithm is HS256 (symmetric HMAC)
        INV-005: JWT_SECRET defaults to 'your-secret-key-change-in-production' if env unset
    end note

---
title: "verifyAccessToken (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_verify: jwt.verify(token, JWT_SECRET, options)
    q_verify --> q_extract: verification succeeded
    q_verify --> q_error: verification throws error
    q_extract --> q_build: extract sub, display_name, discord_id, generation, status, scope
    q_build --> [*]: return JWTPayload
    q_error --> q_log: console.error('Token verification failed:', error)
    q_log --> [*]: return null

    note right of q_verify
        INV-001: algorithms restricted to HS256 only
        INV-002: issuer must match JWT_ISSUER
        INV-003: audience validated against clientId if provided
        INV-004: Returns null on any verification failure (no exception propagation)
        INV-005: clientId is optional; if undefined, audience check is skipped
    end note

---
title: "getAuthCodeExpiry (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_calc: expiry = Date.now() + 10min * 1000
    q_calc --> [*]: return new Date(expiry)

    note right of q_calc
        INV-001: Expiry is exactly 10 minutes from invocation time
        INV-002: TOKEN_EXPIRY.AUTHORIZATION_CODE = 600 seconds
    end note

---
title: "isValidRedirectUri (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check: allowedUris.includes(redirectUri)
    q_check --> q_valid: found in allowedUris
    q_check --> q_invalid: not found in allowedUris
    q_valid --> [*]: return true
    q_invalid --> [*]: return false

    note right of q_check
        INV-001: Exact string match only (no normalization, no wildcard)
        INV-002: Returns true iff redirectUri is in allowedUris array
    end note

---
title: "createOAuthError (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_init: result = { error }
    q_init --> q_check_desc: description provided?
    q_check_desc --> q_add_desc: description != undefined
    q_check_desc --> q_return: description == undefined
    q_add_desc --> q_return: result.error_description = description
    q_return --> [*]: return result

    note right of q_init
        INV-001: result.error is always set
        INV-002: result.error_description is set only if description is truthy
    end note

---
title: "redirectWithError (stem-system oauth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_parse: url = new URL(redirectUri)
    q_parse --> q_set_error: url.searchParams.set('error', error.error)
    q_set_error --> q_check_desc: error.error_description exists?
    q_check_desc --> q_set_desc: error_description != undefined
    q_check_desc --> q_check_state: error_description == undefined
    q_set_desc --> q_check_state: url.searchParams.set('error_description', ...)
    q_check_state --> q_set_state: state != undefined
    q_check_state --> q_return: state == undefined
    q_set_state --> q_return: url.searchParams.set('state', state)
    q_return --> [*]: return url.toString()

    note right of q_parse
        INV-001: redirectUri must be a valid URL (new URL throws otherwise)
        INV-002: error param is always present in returned URL
        INV-003: state param preserved if provided (CSRF protection)
        INV-004: No validation of redirectUri against allowed list (caller responsibility)
    end note

---
title: "GET /oauth/authorize (stem-system OAuth)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_parse: parse searchParams from request.url
    q_parse --> q_validate_required: extract clientId, redirectUri, state, codeChallenge, codeChallengeMethod, responseType, scope
    q_validate_required --> q_err_missing: !clientId || !redirectUri || !codeChallenge || !state
    q_err_missing --> [*]: return 400 invalid_request "Missing required parameters"
    q_validate_required --> q_validate_response_type: all required params present
    q_validate_response_type --> q_err_response_type: responseType != "code"
    q_err_response_type --> [*]: return 400 unsupported_response_type
    q_validate_response_type --> q_validate_pkce: responseType == "code"
    q_validate_pkce --> q_err_pkce: codeChallengeMethod != "S256"
    q_err_pkce --> [*]: return 400 invalid_request "Only S256 supported"
    q_validate_pkce --> q_auth_check: codeChallengeMethod == "S256"
    q_auth_check --> q_get_user: supabase = createClient()
    q_get_user --> q_check_logged_in: getUser()
    q_check_logged_in --> q_redirect_login: authError || !user
    q_redirect_login --> [*]: set oauth_redirect cookie, redirect 307 to /login
    q_check_logged_in --> q_validate_client: user authenticated
    q_validate_client --> q_rpc_client: rpc get_application_by_client_id(clientId)
    q_rpc_client --> q_err_client: appError || !application
    q_err_client --> [*]: return 400 invalid_client "Unknown client_id"
    q_rpc_client --> q_validate_redirect: application found
    q_validate_redirect --> q_err_redirect: !isValidRedirectUri(redirectUri, application.redirect_uris)
    q_err_redirect --> [*]: return 400 invalid_request "Invalid redirect_uri"
    q_validate_redirect --> q_check_consent: redirectUri valid
    q_check_consent --> q_rpc_consent: rpc check_user_consent(user.id, application.id)
    q_rpc_consent --> q_build_consent_url: build consent URL with all params
    q_build_consent_url --> q_set_already_consented: existingConsent == true
    q_build_consent_url --> q_redirect_consent: existingConsent == false
    q_set_already_consented --> q_redirect_consent: set already_consented=true
    q_redirect_consent --> [*]: redirect 307 to /oauth/authorize/consent

    note right of q_validate_required
        INV-001: All of clientId, redirectUri, codeChallenge, state must be non-null before proceeding
    end note

    note right of q_validate_pkce
        INV-002: PKCE code_challenge_method must be S256 (plain not accepted)
    end note

    note right of q_redirect_login
        INV-003: oauth_redirect cookie is httpOnly, secure when HTTPS, sameSite=lax, maxAge=600s
    end note

    note right of q_validate_redirect
        INV-004: redirectUri must match one of the registered redirect_uris for the application
    end note

    note right of q_redirect_consent
        INV-005: All original OAuth params are forwarded to consent page via query string
    end note

---
title: "Parameter Validation (stem-system OAuth Authorize)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_parse: parse URL searchParams
    q_parse --> q_extract: clientId = get("client_id"), redirectUri = get("redirect_uri"), state = get("state"), codeChallenge = get("code_challenge"), codeChallengeMethod = get("code_challenge_method"), responseType = get("response_type"), scope = get("scope") || "openid profile"
    q_extract --> q_check_required: validate required params
    q_check_required --> q_err_missing: !clientId || !redirectUri || !codeChallenge || !state
    q_err_missing --> [*]: return 400 invalid_request
    q_check_required --> q_check_response_type: all required present
    q_check_response_type --> q_err_response_type: responseType != "code"
    q_err_response_type --> [*]: return 400 unsupported_response_type
    q_check_response_type --> q_check_pkce: responseType == "code"
    q_check_pkce --> q_err_pkce: codeChallengeMethod != "S256"
    q_err_pkce --> [*]: return 400 invalid_request "Only S256 supported"
    q_check_pkce --> [*]: all validations passed

    note right of q_extract
        INV-001: scope defaults to "openid profile" if not provided
    end note

    note right of q_check_required
        INV-002: Four params are mandatory: client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, state
        INV-003: response_type is validated separately but is also effectively required (must be "code")
    end note

    note right of q_check_pkce
        INV-004: Only S256 PKCE method accepted; plain PKCE is rejected
    end note

---
title: "Authentication Check and Login Redirect (stem-system OAuth Authorize)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_create_client: supabase = createClient()
    q_create_client --> q_get_user: supabase.auth.getUser()
    q_get_user --> q_check_auth: evaluate authError, user
    q_check_auth --> q_build_login_url: authError || !user
    q_check_auth --> [*]: user authenticated (proceed to client validation)
    q_build_login_url --> q_set_cookie: loginUrl = new URL("/login", request.url), loginUrl.set("redirect", request.url)
    q_set_cookie --> q_redirect: response.cookies.set("oauth_redirect", oauthPath, httpOnly=true, secure=isHTTPS, sameSite="lax", maxAge=600, path="/")
    q_redirect --> [*]: return redirect 307 to loginUrl

    note right of q_set_cookie
        INV-001: oauth_redirect cookie stores path+query only (not full URL) to prevent internal URL leakage
        INV-002: Cookie is httpOnly to prevent client-side JS access
        INV-003: Cookie secure flag is conditional on HTTPS (request.url.startsWith("https"))
        INV-004: Cookie expires in 600 seconds (10 minutes)
    end note

---
title: "Client Application Validation (stem-system OAuth Authorize)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_rpc_lookup: supabase.rpc("get_application_by_client_id", clientId)
    q_rpc_lookup --> q_check_app: evaluate appError, application
    q_check_app --> q_err_client: appError || !application
    q_err_client --> [*]: return 400 invalid_client "Unknown client_id"
    q_check_app --> q_validate_redirect: application found
    q_validate_redirect --> q_err_redirect: !isValidRedirectUri(redirectUri, application.redirect_uris)
    q_err_redirect --> [*]: return 400 invalid_request "Invalid redirect_uri"
    q_validate_redirect --> [*]: client and redirect_uri valid

    note right of q_rpc_lookup
        INV-001: Client lookup uses RPC (not direct table query) for access control
    end note

    note right of q_validate_redirect
        INV-002: redirect_uri must match a pre-registered URI for the client application
        INV-003: Redirect URI validation happens AFTER client_id validation (prevents probing)
    end note

---
title: "Consent Check and Redirect (stem-system OAuth Authorize)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_rpc_consent: supabase.rpc("check_user_consent", user.id, application.id)
    q_rpc_consent --> q_build_url: consentUrl = new URL("/oauth/authorize/consent", request.url)
    q_build_url --> q_set_params: set client_id, redirect_uri, state, code_challenge, code_challenge_method, scope, app_name on consentUrl
    q_set_params --> q_check_existing: evaluate existingConsent
    q_check_existing --> q_mark_consented: existingConsent == true
    q_mark_consented --> q_redirect: consentUrl.set("already_consented", "true")
    q_check_existing --> q_redirect: existingConsent == false
    q_redirect --> [*]: return redirect 307 to consentUrl

    note right of q_set_params
        INV-001: All original OAuth parameters are forwarded to the consent page
        INV-002: app_name from DB is passed to consent UI for display
    end note

    note right of q_mark_consented
        INV-003: Previously consented users see already_consented=true flag (consent page may auto-approve)
    end note
